requirements.title: Research scope and terminology are separated
requirements.objective: Distinguish roadmap P6 research, prior P2 research, unresolved gaps, readiness evaluation, future production implementation and future runtime activation, and record roadmap-versus-executed discrepancies explicitly rather than reconciling them silently.
acceptance_criteria: All six layers are separately documented
Roadmap-versus-executed discrepancies are recorded, not reconciled
P2 research is not presented as P6 research

verification.observed_result: Section 2 confirms the scope document exists as a roadmap deliverable; its six sections and the discrepancy table were read back during validation.

requirements.title: Readiness evaluator gates technology use
requirements.objective: Compute readiness from evidence and refuse to select any technology that is not SUFFICIENT, which is the roadmap P6 acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: All ten coverage areas and a source of rank <= 4 are required
An unresolved conflict hard-blocks a technology
Readiness is computed, never read from a stored label
An unresearched technology is UNRESEARCHED and not selectable

verification.observed_result: Sections 4 and 5 confirm readiness is computed per entry, POSCTRL-P6 proves the evaluator refuses a weak-source entry, and the gate blocked TECH-WEB-VITALS, TECH-SPS-CMS and a nonexistent technology while allowing only TECH-PYTHON-STDLIB.

requirements.title: Research entries are evidence-based and attributed
requirements.objective: Every recorded fact must come from an attributed source; anything not observed is recorded UNKNOWN rather than supplied from model knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: Every entry carries an observation basis and a research date
Every source carries a reference and what was observed in it
No entry stores a readiness label

verification.observed_result: Section 3 confirmed all three entries carry an observation basis, a date, attributed sources with references and observations, and all ten coverage areas.

acceptance_criteria: CLS figures are recorded only with verbatim rank-1 quotes

verification.observed_result: Section 6 confirmed CONF-001 is still recorded UNRESOLVED and that six independent regex probes find no LCP or INP numeric value in the cache. Negative case N13 independently re-checks this.

requirements.title: D-P6-2 runtime boundaries enforced

CAP-P03-005 remains DEFERRED

verification.observed_result: Section 7 confirmed no runtime state, exactly four production capabilities, CAP-P03-005 DEFERRED, and a pure offline evaluator. Section 9 confirmed no machine-global path and no P7 artefact.
